name: EjectADF
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS 3.2 or later with WBStartup, ARexx, and the WORKBENCH ARexx port
C:DAControl and trackfile.device for AmigaOS-mounted ADF images
notes: The pinned Aminet 1.0 archive supplies Michael Spindler’s launcher, handler script and in-archive readme. The checked BCWB project icon supplies the stock ARexx startup configuration.

The startup project registers the Eject ADF image menu entry. It requests Right Amiga+period, which is already assigned to Workbench Clean Up by Column on AmigaOS 3.2.2.1. The shipped handler reads selected root icons and dispatches DAControl INFO and EJECT DEVICE.
The shared system supplies the startup sequence and OS interfaces. This package owns no drawers.
